tasks: Text Query Generation For Image Retrieval
outputs: open-ended textual instructions describing the relationship between two images
textual instructions T q→t i describing transitions from query to target images

changes_made.explanation: Minor normalization of model names. The original extraction was accurate.
Removed all retrieval evaluation metrics as they measure retrieval performance, not NLG output quality. The paper does not use NLG-specific automatic metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, etc.
No LLMs are used as judges to evaluate the generated outputs. LLMs are only used for generation, not evaluation.
The paper does not conduct human evaluation of the generated text queries/instructions.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on generating textual instructions for image retrieval tasks but does not evaluate the NLG outputs using NLG-specific automatic metrics or human evaluation. The evaluation focuses on retrieval performance of the multimodal models trained with the generated instructions, not on the quality of the generated text itself.
